ticket.title: Preserve the return destination after a password reset
ticket.description: A passenger can start a password reset while viewing a protected Spaceways page. The reset request carries that page as `returnTo`, and the passenger should go back there after choosing a new password. Review how that request value travels through the changed files and decide whether the emailed link keeps it inside Spaceways.
requirements: Accept an optional returnTo value from the reset request and preserve it in the password-reset link.
A reset email must never send the passenger to a destination outside the Spaceways application.

pr.title: Keep passenger return path in password reset emails
pr.description: Passes the requested return path from the password-reset handler into the link builder so passengers can resume their journey after resetting a password.
pr.author: orbit-dev

aiReview.summary: Follow `returnTo` through both changed files, then compare the resulting link behavior with the ticket's destination requirement.

findings.title: Inspect how the reset link handles its destination
findings.detail: Check whether the link builder distinguishes an application path from a destination outside Spaceways.

findings.title: Trace the request value across the changed files
findings.detail: Identify where `returnTo` originates and how the receiving function uses it to construct the email link.

proposedAnswer.reason: The handler passes request-controlled returnTo to the link builder, and the builder embeds it in the trusted reset email without validating the destination.
